channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Rose Marie Berg
item.description: Rose Marie Berg, age 79, of Austin, Minnesota, passed away peacefully on Monday, February 9, 2026, surrounded by her loving family at her daughter’s home in Algona, Iowa.

item.title: Minnesota sues after CDC cuts millions of dollars in public health grants
item.description: Minnesota sues the federal government after $42M in CDC public health funding is cut, winning a 14-day court order that temporarily blocks the Trump administration’s grant cancellation.

item.title: Arndt closes in on single season rebounding mark, but Packers fall short
item.description: Faribault defeats Austin 69-41, as senior Gracie Arndt's 9-point, 9-rebound effort brings her within 11 boards of the Packers' single-season rebounding record.

item.title: Packer boys hockey team drops regular season finale
item.description: Austin boys hockey falls 4-2 at Rochester Century/John Marshall in regular-season finale, despite goals from Kyler Flanders and Logan Ruther-Wencl.

item.title: Packer boys clip Falcons in Faribault
item.description: Cole Hebrink poured in 24 points as Austin topped Faribault 76-64 on the road, improving to 12-7 and dropping the Falcons to 8-13.

item.title: Cobras slide past Blooming Prairie girls
item.description: Claire Schwarz scores 22 as Blooming Prairie battles but falls to Triton; coach John Worke praises improved competitiveness and late-game opportunities.

item.title: Lyle-Pacelli boys bring down Kingsland
item.description: Grady Meyer scored 17 points as Lyle-Pacelli defeated Kingsland 85-49 on the road, improving to 8-15 overall while Kingsland dropped to 1-22.

item.title: Lee sets single season rebounding record, but BP falls to Cobras
item.description: Kingston Lee sets Blooming Prairie single-season rebounding record, but Triton's Pierce Petersohn scores 44 in Cobras' 89-59 win over BP.

item.title: JWP outlasts Southland girls basketball team
item.description: Janesville-Waldorf-Pemberton tops Southland 71-62 despite 21 points from Juliette Matheis, handing the 20-4 Rebels a road loss.

item.title: Razorbacks take down Blue Earth in Section 2A quarterfinals
item.description: No. 4 Westfield Razorbacks beat No. 5 Blue Earth Area 38-25 in the Section 2A quarterfinal and advance to face top-seeded Kenyon-Wanamingo in Saturday’s semifinal in Waterville.
